verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy says its own checkout accepts up to 21 payment methods, including PayPal, all under one roof. Community fee discussion corroborates that PayPal is offered. None of the named methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) are specifically evidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Apple Pay and Google Pay support, bank-redirect/local methods, BNPL options, details on how methods are enabled through the single integration, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: With Lemon Squeezy, you can **accept up to 21 payment methods**, including PayPal, all under one roof.
you can **embed your checkout** or **share your unique checkout links** and sell anywhere
